import sys
try:
    from z3 import Solver, Bool, Or, Not, And, sat, PbEq, If, BoolVal
    print("z3 imported successfully")
except Exception as e:
    print("Error importing z3:", e)
    sys.exit(1)

edges = [
    (0,3), (0,6), (0,8), (1,2), (1,18), (1,20), (1,21), (2,3), (2,15), (2,20),
    (3,5), (3,7), (3,8), (3,12), (3,13), (3,15), (3,18), (4,16), (5,8), (5,11),
    (5,15), (5,16), (5,18), (5,20), (5,21), (6,9), (6,10), (6,18), (7,11), (7,12),
    (7,21), (8,11), (8,12), (8,13), (8,15), (8,20), (8,21), (9,15), (9,19), (10,12),
    (10,15), (10,16), (10,21), (11,13), (11,17), (11,19), (11,21), (12,14), (12,19),
    (13,15), (13,16), (13,17), (14,16), (14,19), (14,20), (15,21), (16,20), (17,18)
]

n = 22
adj = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]
for u,v in edges:
    adj[u][v] = True
    adj[v][u] = True

# Create variables
x = [[Bool(f"x_{i}_{v}") for v in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

s = Solver()

# Fix vertex 0 at position 0
s.add(x[0][0])

# Each position has exactly one vertex
for i in range(n):
    s.add(PbEq([(x[i][v], 1) for v in range(n)], 1))

# Each vertex appears exactly once
for v in range(n):
    s.add(PbEq([(x[i][v], 1) for i in range(n)], 1))

# Adjacency constraints for consecutive positions (including last-first)
for i in range(n):
    nxt = (i+1)%n
    for u in range(n):
        for v in range(n):
            if u != v and not adj[u][v]:
                s.add(Or(Not(x[i][u]), Not(x[nxt][v])))

print("Number of assertions:", len(s.assertions()))
print("Solving...")
res = s.check()
print("Result:", res)

if res == sat:
    m = s.model()
    perm = [None]*n
    for i in range(n):
        for v in range(n):
            if m.evaluate(x[i][v]):
                perm[i] = v
                break
    print("Permutation:", perm)
    # Verify
    ok = True
    for i in range(n):
        u = perm[i]
        v = perm[(i+1)%n]
        if not adj[u][v]:
            print(f"Bad edge at {i}: {u}-{v}")
            ok = False
    print("Valid:", ok)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
